mechanism_notes: Selection is resolved through compiler layers into a semantic event. A downward link feeds explicit interaction mapping, and each update operator reaches its corresponding canvas change. No bypass, reverse arrow, faux writing or brush/warning glyph remains.

visual_signature.layout: Two offset horizontal strata, event resolution at upper left and explicit update mapping lower center, three operator branches on right returning to rendered changes. Use abstract selected marks only, no fabricated data, axes or dashboard.
visual_signature.palette: violet indigo with amber event accents

mobile_limitations: Dense explanatory text requires opening the original at full size on mobile; thumbnail hierarchy is reviewed separately after publication.
